segments.en: Life, peace, and all good forever, and a kosher and joyful Passover — to the honored selves of our beloved dear friends, our dear companions — all the fellowship — our Master R' Noton, may he live — and our Master R' Shlomo, may he live — and our Master R' Alter Ben Tzion — and our Master R' Dovid Shtefir — and our Master R' Yechiel — all of them shall stand under the blessing. Amen, so may it be His will.
